title.zh: Gemini 4 Neon：面向复杂任务的新模型

excerpt.zh: Gemini 4 Neon 主打复杂软件工程、知识工作与科学任务中的快速端到端执行，并提供百万 token 上下文；实际表现仍需结合独立评测与生产场景验证。
excerpt.en: Gemini 4 Neon targets faster end-to-end work across software engineering, knowledge tasks, and science, with a one-million-token context window. Independent results and real-world use still warrant scrutiny.

disclosure.zh: 本文使用星期天AI中转站大模型，基于 Hacker News 内容自动生成。
disclosure.en: This article was automatically generated by the Weekly Day AI gateway model using content from Hacker News.

text.zh: Google DeepMind 发布 Gemini 4 Neon，定位为可快速完成复杂软件工程、知识工作和科学流程的模型。官方称其能在百万 token 上下文中整合文档、表格、图表、音频和视频等输入，并生成结构化成果。
text.en: Google DeepMind has introduced Gemini 4 Neon, a model aimed at quickly completing complex software engineering, knowledge-work, and science workflows. Google says it can combine documents, spreadsheets, charts, audio, and video within a one-million-token context window and produce structured outputs.

text.zh: Gemini 4 Neon 的评测表现与适用场景
text.en: Gemini 4 Neon benchmarks and intended workloads

text.zh: 发布材料列出多项基准成绩：在 Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index 的 xhigh 推理档位得分 61、排名第三；在 Vals Index 排名第二。Google 还报告称，该模型在若干法律、税务、自动化、编程及科学测试中排名靠前。基准成绩反映特定测试条件，不等同于所有工作环境中的实际效果。
text.en: The announcement reports several benchmark results: a score of 61 and third place on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index at the xhigh reasoning level, and second place on the Vals Index. Google also reports leading positions on selected legal, tax, automation, coding, and science tests. Benchmark results reflect particular test conditions and do not guarantee performance in every workplace.

text.zh: 面向开发者，Google 强调 Neon 能处理跨文件调试与重构，并支持长时、多工具的智能体任务；在 Antigravity 中，它也可协调并行子智能体。模型提供四档思考强度，供团队在任务质量与 token 支出之间调整。官方称其在部分对比中每项任务成本较低，但成本和速度仍会随工作负载、设置及平台而变。
text.en: For developers, Google highlights Neon’s ability to debug and refactor across files and handle long-running, tool-heavy agent tasks; in Antigravity, it can also coordinate parallel subagents. Four thinking levels let teams adjust the tradeoff between task performance and token spend. Google reports lower cost per task in some comparisons, though cost and speed will vary with workload, settings, and platform.

text.zh: Gemini 4 Neon 的安全、价格与待验证之处
text.en: Gemini 4 Neon safety, pricing, and open questions

text.zh: API 定价为每百万输入 token 3 美元、缓存输入 token 0.15 美元、输出 token 15 美元。发布信息称模型正通过 Gemini API、部分 Gemini 商业服务、Antigravity 和 Gemini 应用逐步开放；Neon for cyber 则计划先向可信防御者提供。Google 表示安全防护延续 Gemini 4 Carbon 的严重滥用与提示注入防护，并继续改进模型对齐和智能体行为。
text.en: API pricing is $3 per million input tokens, $0.15 per million cached input tokens, and $15 per million output tokens. Google says access is rolling out through the Gemini API, selected Gemini business offerings, Antigravity, and the Gemini app; Neon for cyber is initially planned for trusted defenders. The company says the model retains Gemini 4 Carbon-level protections against severe misuse and prompt injection while improving alignment and agent behavior.

text.zh: 目前仍需关注的重点，是长流程任务中的可靠性、减少编造的效果，以及安全措施在真实部署中的表现。发布材料提到内部测试和多项基准，但不能替代独立复现或组织自身的评估。对于高风险用途，团队仍需验证输出、权限边界与成本，并按照现有安全流程部署。
text.en: Key questions remain about reliability over long workflows, how well fabrication is reduced, and how safeguards perform in real deployments. The announcement cites internal testing and numerous benchmarks, but these are not substitutes for independent replication or an organization’s own evaluation. For high-stakes uses, teams still need to verify outputs, access boundaries, and costs, and deploy within their existing safety processes.
